units.source_text: 老夫人淌着眼泪对小少将君说道：“我此刻略觉好些，去请公主到这里来吧。

en.t: The old lady, tears streaming down her face, said to Lady Koshosho, “I feel a little better now. Please go and ask the princess to come here.

units.source_text: 本当我去望她，实在走不动。我似觉长久不见她了。”

en.t: I ought to go and see her myself, but I truly cannot walk. It feels as though I have not seen her for a very long time.”

units.source_text: 小少将君来到公主房中，对她说道：“老夫人请公主到那边去。”

en.t: Lady Koshosho went to the princess’s room and said to her, “The old lady asks Your Highness to come over to her.”

units.source_text: 公主想要去见母亲，便把泪湿的额发梳掠一番，又把破绽了的单衫脱去，另换一件。

en.t: The princess wanted to see her mother, so she smoothed the hair on her forehead, wet with tears, took off her torn unlined robe, and changed into another one.

units.source_text: 然而不肯立刻就走。她想：“这些侍女对昨夜之事不知如何想法。

en.t: Yet she would not leave at once. She thought, “I wonder what these gentlewomen think about what happened last night.

units.source_text: 母亲还全不知情，日后隐约闻此消息，势必怪我欺瞒，教我何以为颜？”

en.t: Mother still knows nothing at all. If she later hears some vague rumor of it, she will surely blame me for deceiving her. How could I face her then?”

units.source_text: 便又躺下了。对小少将君说：“我好难过啊！

en.t: So she lay down again and said to Lady Koshosho, “I feel so wretched!

units.source_text: 但愿就此不起，倒也落得干净。我的脚气病发了。”

en.t: If only I could never rise from here, that would at least be a clean end. My beriberi has flared up.”

units.source_text: 便叫小少将君按摩一下。她每逢心绪不佳、忧愁过度之时，此病必然发作。

en.t: She then asked Lady Koshosho to massage her. Whenever her spirits were low and her grief became too much, this illness always came on.

units.source_text: 小少将君对她言道：“昨夜之事，老夫人已有所闻了。

en.t: Lady Koshosho said to her, “The old lady has already heard something about last night.

units.source_text: 她今天问我究竟是怎么一回事，我已如实告诉她，但说纸隔扇是紧闭的，

en.t: Today she asked me what had really happened, and I told her the truth, but I said that the paper partition was tightly closed,

units.source_text: 又添了些使她放心的话。如果她问起公主，请公主照我一样回答。”

en.t: and I added a few words to put her mind at ease. If she asks Your Highness about it, please answer just as I did.”

units.source_text: 但老夫人悲叹之状，她不告诉公主。公主听了觉得果然不出所料，非常伤心。

en.t: But she did not tell the princess how bitterly the old lady had lamented. When the princess heard this, she felt it was just as she had feared, and was deeply grieved.

units.source_text: 她一言不发，眼泪像雨滴一般从枕上流下。

en.t: She said not a word, while her tears fell from the pillow like drops of rain.

units.source_text: 她回思过去，不但此事而已，自从意外地下嫁以来，使母亲伤心的事已不少了。

en.t: Looking back over the past, she saw that it was not only this matter; ever since her unexpected marriage beneath her rank, she had caused her mother no small amount of sorrow.

units.source_text: 便觉此身全无生趣。料想此人不会就此罢休，将来势必再来缠绕，外间传说何等难听！

en.t: She felt there was no joy at all in living. She imagined that this man would not stop here, but would surely come to trouble her again, and how ugly the rumors outside would be!

units.source_text: 她左思右想，不胜烦恼。况且无法辩解，任人讥议，今后将流传何等可耻的恶名！

en.t: She turned it over and over in her mind, unable to bear her distress. Besides, she had no way to defend herself and could only leave others to mock her; what a shameful bad name would spread from now on!

units.source_text: 虽然不曾失身，聊可自慰，但念金枝玉叶之身，如此轻率地与人会面，实甚不该。

en.t: Although she had not lost her chastity, which gave her some slight comfort, she thought that for someone of such noble birth to have met a man so carelessly was truly improper.

units.source_text: 自伤宿世命穷，心中好生委屈。

en.t: She lamented that her fate from a former life was so unfortunate, and in her heart she felt deeply wronged.
